## Services — Detailed Descriptions

### Tax Services
FHF tax professionals provide comprehensive tax planning and compliance services for individuals, families, and businesses of all sizes. Beyond simple tax return preparation, FHF identifies multi-year strategies to minimize tax burden.

Includes: individual and business tax return preparation, multi-year strategic tax planning, IRS audit representation, state and local tax compliance, tax-efficient business structuring.

### Assurance Services
FHF delivers audits, reviews, and compilations with objectivity and thoroughness. Serves privately held companies, nonprofits, and employee benefit plans.

Includes: financial statement audits, review and compilation engagements, employee benefit plan audits, nonprofit organization audits, internal control assessments.

### Small Business Accounting
FHF serves as an outsourced accounting department for small businesses, handling day-to-day financial record-keeping.

Includes: monthly bookkeeping and reconciliation, financial statement preparation, payroll processing and reporting, cash flow management, QuickBooks setup and training.

### Business Valuations
FHF holds the ABV (Accredited in Business Valuation) credential and provides defensible valuations for a wide range of purposes.

Includes: buy-sell agreement valuations, estate and gift tax valuations, ESOP feasibility and valuation, litigation support valuations, M&A due diligence.

### Litigation Support
FHF provides forensic accounting, expert witness services (CFF credentialed), and financial analysis for legal matters.

Includes: expert witness testimony, forensic accounting investigations, lost profits and damages calculations, business dispute financial analysis, divorce financial analysis.

### Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOP)
ESOPs are a business succession and tax planning tool. FHF guides owners from feasibility through ongoing compliance.

Includes: ESOP feasibility studies, transaction advisory and structuring, annual ESOP valuations, DOL audit representation, ongoing trustee and plan advisory.

### Employee Benefit Plan Audits
Plans with 100+ eligible participants generally require an annual independent audit under ERISA. FHF has extensive experience with 401(k), 403(b), and profit-sharing plans.

Includes: 401(k) and 403(b) plan audits, ERISA compliance review, DOL examination support, plan correction consulting, Form 5500 preparation.

### Business Advisory
FHF advisors serve as a sounding board and strategic partner for business owners.

Includes: business succession planning, buy-sell agreement structuring, profit improvement analysis, cash flow forecasting, strategic planning facilitation.

### Trust & Estate Tax Planning
FHF works with families and estate planning attorneys to minimize estate and gift taxes and structure trusts efficiently.

Includes: estate and gift tax planning, fiduciary income tax returns (Form 1041), trust administration coordination, generation-skipping transfer tax planning, charitable giving strategies.

---

## Industries / Client Sectors

### Family & Closely Held Businesses
Unique blend of personal and business financial concerns, succession planning, buy-sell agreements, family business legacy protection.

### Real Estate
Cost segregation, 1031 exchanges, passive activity rules, entity structuring for investors, developers, and operators.

### Manufacturing & Distribution
Inventory accounting, cost accounting, R&D tax credits, operational insight for margin improvement and growth management.

### Restaurants & Retail
Cash management, sales tax compliance, financial oversight for operators.

### Healthcare & Medical Practices
Practice management advisory, entity structuring, retirement plan optimization, complex healthcare tax issues for physicians, dentists, and healthcare organizations.

### Nonprofit Organizations
Audit services, Form 990 preparation, advisory for boards, fiduciary responsibility support, public trust maintenance.

### Individuals & High Net Worth
Personalized tax planning, investment tax strategy, estate planning coordination for executives, business owners, retirees, and investors.

## Key Differentiators

1. Founded 1933 — nearly a century of continuous service in Ohio
2. Local and independent — not a national chain or franchise
3. Consistent staff continuity — clients keep the same team year after year
4. Full-service firm — from basic bookkeeping to complex ESOP and forensic accounting
5. Three Ohio offices — Greater Cincinnati, Greater Dayton, and Miami Valley (Troy)
6. Advanced specialty credentials — ABV, CFF, CFP® on staff
